name: SelectUIElement
label: Select UI Element
description: Selects the provided UI element, such as a list item, tab item or combo box option, using UI Automation.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element you would like to select.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: WasSelected
fields.label: Was Selected
fields.description: True if the element was selected successfully, otherwise false.
